verdict.rationale: The only valuation offering documented is the US 409A. A pricing-page line lists 'ESS reporting', which suggests employee share scheme reporting outside the US, but it is a single unexplained mention. The option features cover only US NSO/ISO types, and there is no evidence of UK HMRC/EMI valuations or country-specific option plans. Missing for 10: HMRC/EMI valuation support, EMI or other country-specific option plan types, documentation of how ESS reporting works and which jurisdictions it covers, independent corroboration.
